title: Carousel/Document Post Writer I/O
description: Input/output contract for function 45. Writes a multi-slide LinkedIn carousel/document post AND produces a Canva Bulk Create CSV manifest describing the slide deck. Canva generation is a locally-validated CSV manifest this function produces and checks itself — never a live mcp-canva call from inside this function. Since A3 (2 Sep 2026) the orchestrator consumes that manifest and calls mcp-canva after the draft is written. A second, QA-only input shape (csv_manifest_text/expected_row_count) lets the golden evals exercise the manifest-shape validator directly against a malformed manifest.

proof_points.description: One client-free proof point per carousel slide. Never a fabricated claim.

campaign.description: utm_campaign value for the single call to action.

client_reference.description: Optional client name the caller wants named. Only used if docs/permission-register.yaml confirms CLEARED status; otherwise the carousel is written client-free.

csv_manifest_text.description: QA-only: an already-produced Canva Bulk Create CSV manifest to validate for shape (header row and row count). Not part of the normal generative call shape — used only by the golden eval that proves a malformed manifest is rejected.

expected_row_count.description: QA-only: the data-row count the supplied csv_manifest_text is expected to match.

output.description: Dual-mode output: either the generative carousel-plus-manifest shape, or a verdict shape when the input carries `csv_manifest_text` (the QA/manifest-validation path). The two shapes have disjoint required fields, so exactly one alternative ever matches.

slides.description: One slide per proof point, plus one closing slide carrying the roof line.

canva_bulk_create_csv.description: A Canva Bulk Create CSV manifest body (header row: slide_number,headline,subhead,image_ref,brand_template_id) — one data row per slide, produced and validated locally. This function still makes no live mcp-canva call. RECONCILED 2 Sep 2026 (A3): the manifest is now consumed downstream — the orchestrator's carousel handler parses it and calls mcp-canva's bulk_create_from_csv, which maps it onto Canva's real Autofill API (brand template chosen at the job level, one job per slide, data keyed by the template's own dataset field names). The header is deliberately unchanged; the mapping lives at that boundary, in mcp/mcp-canva/app/dispatch.py.

oneOf.description: QA/verdict-mode output, produced only when the input supplied `csv_manifest_text` for manifest-shape validation.
